name: legitimate-en
comment: Ordinary English legitimate texts: 47 entries (support, invoice, GDPR, quote, logs, code, internal email, contract). Entries flagged `trap: true` are legit-boundary cases designed to resemble a charge — they measure noise, never trigger it.
